verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence of product-native automation is a bare "AI & Automation" feature heading on Recruitee's features page, which suggests an automation capability but does not describe how users set it up or whether it runs in the background. Webhooks, APIs, templates and calendar scheduling are developer building blocks or adjacent features, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documentation of configurable automation rules (triggers, conditions, actions), evidence that they run autonomously in the background or on recurring schedules, details of any AI-driven agentic actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
